attribution.note: Marcus endorses the tentative inference drawn from the cited data.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the tentative inference. In context, enterprise adoption refers to large companies; neither a lasting decline nor a revenue shortfall is asserted.

evidence.note: The contemporaneous Apollo summary establishes the cited concern about large-company adoption. It does not resolve the tentative inference; the underlying estimates were not independently verified.

reviews.rationale: The statement offers a possibility and explicitly leaves open whether the decline is temporary. It supplies no definite outcome or measurable threshold. Under the policy, this tentative inference is not scored.
